headline: Donald Trump really wants Tim Cook to run Nvidia
summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid affair reports. The company's CFO is currently leading on an interim basis. Donald Trump suggests former Apple CEO Tim Cook as the next leader.

headline: Xbox announces Wolfenstein 3
summary: MachineGames announced Wolfenstein 3, nearly a decade after its predecessor. The announcement follows news of The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. This confirms a highly anticipated sequel for Xbox fans.

headline: Whoop launched a social network where every user has a ‘verified heartbeat’
summary: Whoop introduced "Whoop Humans," a new social network for its wearable users. Members can share health metrics, activities, and achievements. The platform emphasizes "entirely human" interactions with verified heartbeat data.

headline: Humble Bundle redesign removes two-factor verification from settings
summary: Humble Bundle's recent redesign removed the option to manage two-factor verification. Users and reports indicate the security feature is missing from settings. This change raises concerns about user account security.

headline: GTA 6's Burger Shot Restaurant Is Expanding Across Florida With Real Meals Inspired by the Game
summary: GTA 6's fictional Burger Shot chain is becoming a real-world restaurant. New locations are opening across Florida, inspired by the game. This collaboration with Skinny Louie brings virtual fast food to life.

headline: The He Who Fights With Monsters Hardcover Books Are on Sale Before Black Friday
summary: Hardcover editions of "He Who Fights With Monsters" are currently on sale. The sale is happening in anticipation of Black Friday. This offers fans a chance to purchase the series at a reduced price.

headline: Wolfenstein 3 Confirmed to Be in Development at MachineGames
summary: Wolfenstein 3 is officially confirmed by developer MachineGames. The announcement came during the Xbox Fanfest, celebrating Xbox's 25th anniversary. This puts long-standing rumors about the sequel to rest.

headline: The Dungeon Crawler Carl Books and Graphic Novels Are on Sale Before Black Friday
summary: "Dungeon Crawler Carl" books and graphic novels are available at a discounted price. The sale precedes the upcoming Black Friday event. Fans can grab the popular series with special offers now.

headline: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amidst a scandal, causing company turmoil. US lawmakers seek to question him regarding an alleged relationship with a Chinese spy. His departure leaves the AI chipmaking giant in an uncertain state.

headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
summary: A Russian warship was reportedly struck by a Ukrainian drone. The incident occurred in the Gulf of Finland. This marks a potential first for Ukrainian drones in the open Baltic Sea.

headline: Junior doctor burnout putting maternity patients at risk, says regulator
summary: A regulator warns that junior doctor burnout endangers maternity patients. Trainee doctors delivering babies face higher rates of overwork. This evidence highlights risks in maternity care due to staffing issues.

headline: Military base asylum plans granted planning approval
summary: Plans to house asylum seekers at a military base have received planning approval. The Home Office's application for up to 1,256 men was fast-tracked. The site is located near Bicester.
